en-US.description: Boost analytical culture inside your company
en-US.longDescription:
With TIMi, companies capitalize on their corporate data to develop new ideas and make critical business decisions faster and easier than ever before.
The TIMi framework is composed of:
Anatella: The heart of TIMi’s Integrated Platform
Modeler: TIMi’s ultimate real-time AUTO-ML engine
Stardust: 3D VR segmentation and visualisation
Kibella: Unlimited self service business Intelligence
en-US.name: TIMi

借助 TIMi，企业能够充分利用其公司数据，以前所未有的速度和便捷度开发新思路并做出关键商业决策。
TIMi 框架由以下核心组件构成：
Anatella：TIMi 集成平台的核心引擎
Modeler：TIMi 终极实时自动机器学习引擎
Stardust：3D 虚拟现实细分与可视化工具
Kibella：无限自助式商业智能平台
